title: The more I read about Atman, the more I wonder: what do I really mean when I say "I"?
excerpt: My body changes. My thoughts change. Even my idea of myself changes. So what is this "I" that stays through all of it?
full_text:
The more I read about Atman, the more I wonder: what do I really mean when I say "I"?

My body changes. My thoughts change. Even my idea of myself changes.

So what is this "I" that stays through all of it?

title: "God is dead. God remains dead. And we have killed him." - Friedrich Nietzsche
excerpt: Nietzsche's real question wasn't about God. It was: if nobody hands you meaning anymore, do you actually have the courage to build your own or do you just grab the nearest replacement dogma and pretend that was your choice all along? That's a harder question than it sounds.
full_text:
"God is dead. God remains dead. And we have killed him."

- Friedrich Nietzsche

Nietzsche's real question wasn't about God. It was: if nobody hands you meaning anymore, do you actually have the courage to build your own or do you just grab the nearest replacement dogma and pretend that was your choice all along?

That's a harder question than it sounds.
